source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. offline flash the signed_broken binary.
2. Power on SUT and observe

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: signed_broken recovery to bmc_signed automatically after power on

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies offline fault stimulus but `mc info` alone cannot prove BIOS-RoT restoration.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds signed artifact, trigger, isolation, console and exact bmc_signed evidence.

original_test_intent: Deliberately program the approved `signed_broken` BIOS-RoT image through the offline path, power on, observe automatic recovery and prove restoration to the expected `bmc_signed` state.
original_method: Validate board-specific fault/recovery artifacts and vendor offline method, preserve logs, isolate the SUT and arm console/OOB recovery, have an engineer perform the offline programming and controlled power-on observation, then verify exact recovered identity and platform health.
manual_activity: The core stimulus is explicitly offline and the source requires observing recovery after physical power-on. An engineer must program the service medium, control power and confirm the recovery sequence; the agent may prepare artifacts and collect/analyze console and BMC evidence only.
required_inputs: Approved signed_broken and bmc_signed artifacts with hashes/signatures
Vendor offline programmer/service medium and procedure
Recovery trigger, timing, expected state/version and console signatures
Isolation, stable power, OOB/serial recovery and approval
safety_requirements: Use only an approved disposable/dedicated SUT and exact target-specific fault image.
Export baseline logs before clearing and preserve complete programmer/console evidence.
Do not interrupt offline programming or improvise power cuts/timing.
Stop on artifact/target ambiguity, programming error, absent recovery trigger or management loss.
No automatic retry or alternate recovery image; follow vendor procedure under engineer direction.
agent_execution_scope: Validate artifact hashes, target, procedure, expected recovery signatures and safety readiness.
Collect programmer output supplied by the operator and synchronized serial/BMC/power evidence.
Compare recovered identity/health and prepare Tool Result without claiming the manual stimulus/observation.
engineer_actions: Approve and perform offline signed_broken programming and controlled power-on.
Observe console/RoT recovery and direct vendor recovery if it fails.
Verify bmc_signed restoration and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `ipmitool mc info` is supplementary BMC evidence and cannot identify BIOS-RoT recovery to a specific signed image by itself; cipher 17 also needs platform validation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the offline source method; use only vendor-defined programming and RoT identity commands, with BMC inventory as additive evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Offline signed_broken stimulus, power-on observation, bmc_signed criterion and 5/20-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: VENDOR OFFLINE RECOVERY FLOW WITH HUMAN CORE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create an artifact/target manifest, capture offline programmer logs and time-aligned console/RoT/BMC state transitions, then prove exact bmc_signed identity and healthy boot under engineer observation.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the BIOS-RoT platform and recovery process documented by its vendor.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record programmer/tool/firmware hashes, board/RoT/BMC revisions and console collector version.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds artifact provenance, isolation, exact recovery identity and evidence/recovery controls without substituting an online flash.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Generic BMC reachability is not proof that the protected BIOS/RoT state recovered correctly.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define platform-specific images, programmer and observation signatures. Such overrides must not replace the offline fault stimulus with an online or simulated event.
expected_evidence: Board/RoT/BMC baseline, artifact hashes/signatures, vendor procedure and approval
Offline programmer/tool identity and complete signed_broken write output
Power-on timestamps and full serial/console/RoT/BMC recovery trace
Exact bmc_signed recovered identity, boot/management health and post events

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently define offline signed_broken stimulus and automatic recovery to bmc_signed; platform-specific details are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The destructive intent is clear. Missing artifacts/procedure prevent execution but do not make the Master Library case semantically BLOCKED; MANUAL ONLY captures the offline core.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps offline/operator boundary but rejects generic BMC readback as acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains all RoT artifact, trigger, console, isolation and recovery controls while applying MANUAL ONLY under V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates agent evidence support from engineer-executed fault stimulus and verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a reachable BMC from being mistaken for successful Root-of-Trust recovery and binds the destructive stimulus to signed platform artifacts.
independent_technical_reasoning: Offline programming and observed automatic recovery are the core acceptance actions, not merely environment setup. They require engineer hardware/service interaction, so MANUAL ONLY is the correct classification.

no_automatic_retry: Do not reprogram the fault image, repeat power-on, try alternate recovery artifacts or reset the controller automatically after failure.
